latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of thesis-discussion-writer skill:

- Generates detailed, academically rigorous Chinese discussion chapters for theses and dissertations based on user-supplied findings, frameworks, literature, and requirements.
- Outputs the full 第五章讨论 or 讨论与结论 section, including study summary, finding-by-finding discussion, integration with theory/literature, implications, recommendations, and conclusions.
- Adapts structure and style based on thesis type (quantitative, qualitative, mixed methods, literature review, intervention-design, etc.).
- Does not invent findings or implications; provides frameworks and exact material requests if user input is incomplete.
- Strictly focused on the discussion chapter—avoids methodology, results, literature review, or unsupported conclusions.
